audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] says the axe slow stops him 'peeling with W', and early says 'his W move speed never lets him peel off'. Blood Hunt (W) is a 4000-range sense that grants move speed toward and attack speed against enemies below 50% health — it peels nothing. His actual peel is Primal Howl (E): 2.5s of damage reduction ending in a 1s fear, on 15/14/13/12/11s.
audit.why: Point 4 is the decisive interaction. A player watching for a phantom W disengage will walk into the fear that actually breaks his stick, and will misjudge when Blood Hunt turns on — it only matters once someone is under 50%.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl (E) is the peel, 15s at rank 1 with 2.5s of damage reduction attached; Blood Hunt is a chase tool that activates below 50% health.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 spike text never gives Infinite Duress's cooldown or duration, and the packet reports zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: 110s at rank 1 for a 1.5s suppression is the single most punishable cooldown in the lane, and Eternal Hunger's healing does nothing above 50% health — that threshold is why Olaf's early burst works and his late brawl does not.
audit.corrected: Infinite Duress 110s / 1.5s suppression; Eternal Hunger heals only below 50% and triples below 25%.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart shows Skill at Levels 1, 4-5 and 6, and Olaf at two-plus items, against a packet chart of Olaf through Level 6 and Warwick at two items — and against whys[6] and late, which both say Warwick reclaims the duel.
audit.why: The page's own prose says Olaf owns everything before items and loses the long game; the chart contradicts both ends.
audit.corrected: Olaf rows 1 through first item; Warwick at two-plus items.

audit.why: Grievous Wounds is correctly core: Jaws of the Beast heals off max-health damage and Eternal Hunger heals below 50%.
53.74% over 977 games supports the Olaf-favoured framing.

edits.before: Warwick is one of the weakest level-1s and has no answer to your Q-slow into auto — stick the axe, walk him down, and don't let him get free Q heals off minions. At Levels 2-3 your E true damage is the whole lane: it ignores his bulk and chunks him for more than his passive can heal back while he's near full HP. Trade in short bursts and pick your axe back up to keep the slow refreshing so his W move speed never lets him peel off.
edits.after: Warwick is one of the weakest level-1s and has no answer to Undertow into autos — stick the axe, walk him down, and deny him free Jaws of the Beast heals off minions. At Levels 2-3 Reckless Swing is the whole lane: true damage ignores his bulk, and above 50% health Eternal Hunger does not heal him at all. Trade short and pick the axe back up — the 9s cooldown refunds, so Primal Howl's 1s fear buys him nothing.

edits.before: Keep forcing short all-ins — your passive ramps attack speed as you take his drain damage, and W omnivamp wins the sustain race a pre-6 Warwick thinks he owns. The danger window is his Level 6 R: never let him channel it on you with no escape, because that suppress feeds his jungler. Bait the R or hold your own Ragnarok — pop it as he ults to cleanse the suppress, then E him out while he's committed and CC-locked into nothing.
edits.after: Keep forcing short all-ins — your passive ramps attack speed and life steal as you take his drain damage, and a pre-6 Warwick loses the sustain race he thinks he owns. The danger window is Level 6: Infinite Duress is 110s and holds you for 1.5 seconds, which is exactly long enough for his jungler. Bait it, or hold Ragnarok and press yours as he leaps so the disable immunity answers the suppress, then Reckless Swing him while he is committed.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in lock. R cleanses the suppress. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1, 1.5s suppression, and Ragnarok answers it. Bait it, then commit. - Primal Howl: 15s, 2.5s damage reduction into a 1s fear. - Jaws of the Beast: 8s, heals off your max health.

notes: Whether Ragnarok's disable immunity breaks an already-applied Infinite Duress suppression, or only prevents it, is not in Riot's text; the copy was kept to 'press it as he leaps' rather than claiming a mid-channel cleanse. Chart flips are matched full/content pairs, one atomic group.
